entities.title: Tests
entities.summary: The library's unittest suites: the shared fixtures, the typed layer, the native adapters, the library's purity, and the example suites in examples/.
entities.purpose: Checks the library without installing it: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests from implementations/python. The suites find the repository root from their own path and read conformance/ and schema/ there in place, never copies.
boundaries: What each suite checks is recorded in verification.json here and in the example folders' own files.
The ZoneInfo tests in test_native.py are skipped when this machine's tz database has no America/New_York.
